messages:
Anna (devex): heads up — Elixir community SDK PR #42 CI started failing on ubuntu-latest elixir 1.15. Logs show TLS handshake errors in integration tests. anyone else seen this?

CI Bot: CI failed — job=integration-elixir-1.15, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/elixir-sdk/actions/runs/123456789 (failed tests: 3) :exclamation:

Samir: can you paste the failing stack trace?

Anna (devex): pasted snippet:
```
20:12:33.123 [error] GenServer HTTPoison.Backend terminating
** (MatchError) no match of right hand side value: {:error, {:tls_alert, 'handshake failure'}}
  (ssl) ssl.erl:XXXX: :ssl.connect/3
  ...
```

Liu Chen: this smells like OTP/openssl mismatch. On 1.15 we bumped OTP to 26 which changed ssl/cipher defaults. Try setting :ssl_options in hacky test to [{:versions, [:":tlsv1.2"]}] or pin elixir to 1.14 in GH Actions matrix.

Maria G: I reproduced on my Mac (M1, Elixir 1.15.2, OTP 26.1). Works if I set env OPENSSL_CONF=/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf (weird). Possibly CA bundle path differs on macOS runners.

Samir: maybe easiest short term is to pin to elixir 1.14 in CI and add a note in CHANGELOG. Long term we should fix test harness to use local CA store or skip external TLS calls.

Anna (devex): agree. I can open a small PR to pin matrix entries & add a test skip flag env var: ELIXIR_SDK_SKIP_INTEGRATION=1

Samir: I'll review. @Maria can you sanity check M1 skip?

Maria G: will do tomorrow :eyes:

Anna (devex): thanks! I'll include a comment in PR explaining the root cause and the follow-up tasks (investigate openssl/OTP, improve mock server). :thumbsup:

CI Bot: PR opened #45 by anna-devex - "ci: pin elixir 1.14 in matrix + opt-out integration tests" — checks: pending.

Samir: lgtm when green. closing in 2 days if no issues.
